theater: 蘇伊士運河與戈蘭高地

battle.name: 第四次中東戰爭
battle.theater: 蘇伊士運河與戈蘭高地
battle.brief: 1973年10月6日，埃及與敘利亞在千餘門火炮掩護下同時攻擊以色列。埃及主力當日渡過蘇伊士運河，突破巴爾萊夫防線並在西奈建立橋頭堡，敘利亞在戈蘭高地正面進攻，以軍於十月中旬反攻奪回陣地。卡面1862年英國鐵甲艦代表的是裝甲優先的設計邏輯，在本役已被反艦導彈徹底顛覆。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 第四次中東戰爭自1973年10月6日開火，至10月22日埃及與以色列接受聯合國安理會第338號決議、10月24日停火，主要交戰方是埃及與敘利亞聯軍以及以色列；約旦一度參戰，其餘阿拉伯國家則以派兵、供油與提供資金的方式支援阿拉伯聯盟。埃及方面由總統安瓦爾·薩達特掌握最高決策，陸軍參謀長先是阿卜杜勒·哈基姆·阿麥爾元帥，10月14日被撤換，10月15日起由穆罕默德·法維茲接掌；第2集團軍由阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜·沙茲利少將、第3集團軍由穆罕默德·阿里·比拉爾少將分別指揮，西部軍區由艾哈邁德·伊斯梅爾·阿里元帥坐鎮，裝甲力量集中於第2、第3裝甲師，總參謀部在開羅策劃全局。敘利亞方面由總統哈菲茲·阿薩德與參謀長穆斯塔法·塔拉斯共同主持，戈蘭方向投入第2、第3裝甲師及第3、第10、第12步兵師等部隊，第2裝甲師由希克馬特·納哈斯少將率領。以色列方面由總理果爾達·梅厄主持，國防部長摩西·達揚實際主導作戰，參謀長先是海姆·巴爾萊夫中將，10月12日起改由什洛莫·吉隆中將接任；南部戰區由阿里埃爾·沙龍少將指揮，裝甲打擊集群由阿夫拉罕·阿丹准將率領，情報部門則由亞哈龍·亞里夫掌管。外交與後勤層面由美國介入，基辛格穿梭斡旋，尼克松政府以「鎳草行動」空運補給，並向以色列提供情報與情報機構支援。
countriesEn: The Fourth Middle East War opened on 6 October 1973 and closed when Egypt and Israel accepted Security Council Resolution 338 on 22 October, with the general ceasefire taking effect on 24 October. The principal belligerents were the Egyptian and Syrian armies on one side and Israel on the other; Jordan entered the war for a short time, and the remaining Arab states supported the Arab coalition by sending troops, supplying oil and providing money. On the Egyptian side the supreme decisions were taken by President Anwar Sadat. The chief of staff was Field Marshal Abdel Hakim Amer until 14 October, when he was dismissed, and Mohamed Fawzi took over on 15 October. The Second Army was commanded by Maj Gen Abdel Wahab El Shazly and the Third Army by Maj Gen Mohammed Ali Bilal, while Field Marshal Ahmed Ismail Ali held the Western Command; the armoured strength was concentrated in the 2nd and 3rd Armoured Divisions, and the General Staff in Cairo ran the war. On the Syrian side President Hafez al-Assad and Chief of Staff Mustafa Tlass shared command, the Golan front absorbing the 2nd and 3rd Armoured Divisions together with the 3rd, 10th and 12th Infantry Divisions, the 2nd Armoured Division being led by Maj Gen Hikmat al-Nahhas. On the Israeli side Prime Minister Golda Meir presided over the war cabinet and Defence Minister Moshe Dayan actually directed operations. The chief of staff was Maj Gen Haim Bar-Lev, replaced on 12 October by Maj Gen Shlomo Gilon; the Southern Command was under Maj Gen Ariel Sharon, the armoured strike group was led by Brig Gen Avraham Adan, and the intelligence service was run by Aharon Yariv. At the diplomatic and logistic level the United States intervened, with Henry Kissinger shuttling between capitals and the Nixon administration flying in supplies under Operation Nickel Grass, backed by intelligence cooperation with Israel.
people: 關鍵人物集中於兩國的最高統帥與前線指揮官。埃及總統薩達特在開戰前已拍板發動一場有限戰爭，10月6日下午兩時下令全線渡河，他頂住蘇聯與阿拉伯聯盟要求撤軍的壓力；參謀長阿麥爾元帥主張乘勢全面深入西奈，10月14日遭撤換，法維茲接手後改為強調鞏固橋頭堡並推動停火談判，第3集團軍司令比拉爾少將指揮渡河與縱深推進，西部軍區的伊斯梅爾·阿里元帥赴前線督戰，沙茲利少將率第2集團軍在運河南岸作戰。敘利亞總統阿薩德與參謀長塔拉斯在開戰首日即遭以軍反擊，納哈斯少將的第2裝甲師在「哭泣谷」正面硬撼以軍裝甲預備隊，其後方補給線在空襲與砲兵打擊下屢屢中斷。以色列方面，總理梅厄主持作戰內閣，國防部長達揚在戰局最困難的階段提議以核武威懾阻止蘇聯介入，參謀長巴爾萊夫因連日失利於10月12日引咎請辭，吉隆中將接任後主導西奈反攻計畫，沙龍少將在南線以果斷的裝甲機動與縮短的指揮鏈重整被打亂的部隊，阿丹准將率納哈爾裝甲師連夜渡河奪回中國農場並解救出被俘的以軍官兵，情報部門雖已掌握開戰時間卻未能阻止戰爭爆發。外交上，美國國務卿基辛格在停火前後往返大馬士革與開羅，侯賽因國王在阿拉伯聯盟壓力與以軍攻勢之下於10月11日宣布約旦退出戰鬥。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities were the supreme commanders and the front-line commanders of the two sides. The Egyptian president Sadat had already approved a limited war before the opening salvo; he ordered the crossing of the canal at 14:00 on 6 October and stood his ground against Soviet and Arab League pressure for a withdrawal. His chief of staff, Field Marshal Amer, wanted to press the advantage with a deep advance into Sinai and was removed on 14 October; Fawzi, who took over, shifted towards consolidating the bridgehead and pressing for a ceasefire, while Third Army commander Bilal directed the crossing and the drive into the interior, Ismail Ali supervised the western front from the forward area, and Shazly fought with the Second Army on the south bank of the canal. On the Syrian side President Assad and Chief of Staff Tlass were hit by the Israeli counterstroke on the first day, and Nahhas's 2nd Armoured Division fought the Israeli armoured reserve head-on in the Valley of Tears while its supply line was repeatedly cut by air strikes and artillery fire. In Israel, Prime Minister Meir chaired the war cabinet, Defence Minister Dayan proposed nuclear blackmail to deter Soviet intervention during the hardest days of the fighting, and Chief of Staff Bar-Lev resigned on 12 October in consequence of the defeats, to be replaced by Gilon, who directed the Sinai counter-offensive. Sharon reorganised the shattered southern front with fast armoured manoeuvre and shortened chains of command, while Adan led the Nahal armoured division across the canal overnight, retook the Chinese Farm and freed the Israeli prisoners held there, and the intelligence service, though it knew the date of the opening, failed to prevent the war. On the diplomatic side United States Secretary of State Kissinger travelled repeatedly between Damascus and Cairo around the ceasefire, and King Hussein withdrew Jordan from the fighting on 11 October under combined Arab League pressure and Israeli pressure on the Golan front.
kits: 卡面那艘1862年英國鐵甲艦代表的是「裝甲壓倒火炮」的時代開端，而本役的裝備版圖已被徹底改寫。埃及與敘利亞陸軍以蘇制T-54、T-55與T-62中型坦克為主，配B-10、B-11步兵戰鬥車與大量半履帶裝甲車，埃及第2、第3裝甲師集中了約二千輛坦克；反裝甲主力是AT-3「薩格」反戰車導彈，由Mi-8與Mi-24直升機在低空協同發射，頭幾日消耗逾兩千發，並配以自行反戰車炮與120公厘反戰車炮。以色列方面以M-48「馬加奇」、M-60「百夫長」與「百夫長」改型車為核心，配M113裝甲車與M-60A1裝甲反戰車車，反戰車導彈採用激光製導的「米贊」系列，可在對方的反坦克導彈命中前先行鎖定目標。砲兵方面，埃及有152公厘自行榴彈炮與「薩米德」105公厘自行砲，敘利亞有BM-21「喀秋莎」火箭炮，以色列有155公厘自行榴彈炮與「所羅門」自行追擊砲。航空兵力上，以軍有「幻影」IIIC與IIJD、「超級軍旗」戰鬥機、A-4「天鷹」、F-4「鬼怪」與A-6「攻擊者」攻擊機；埃及有MiG-21MF、MiG-17F與Su-7戰鬥轟炸機。海上差距最大：以色列有「薩阿」4.5級導彈艇、驅逐艦「埃拉特」號與潛艇「達卡爾」號，埃及有蘇製「科馬爾」級導彈艇與641型潛艇，艇上攜帶的「Styx」反艦導彈正是本役擊沉兩艘以色列軍艦的兵器；而「埃拉特」號本身是由英國「County」級驅逐艦改裝而來，與卡面鐵甲艦同屬英國造船的血統。
kitsEn: The 1862 British ironclad on the card embodies the opening of an era in which armour overawed guns, while the equipment landscape of this war had been rewritten from end to end. The Egyptian and Syrian armies were built on Soviet T-54, T-55 and T-62 medium tanks, with B-10 and B-11 infantry fighting vehicles and a large number of half-tracks, the 2nd and 3rd Armoured Divisions together holding roughly two thousand tanks; the principal anti-armour weapon was the AT-3 Sagger guided missile, fired in coordinated low-level attacks by Mi-8 and Mi-24 helicopters, more than two thousand rounds being expended in the first days, backed by self-propelled anti-tank guns and 120mm anti-tank guns. Israel, for its part, built on the M-48 Magach and the M-60 Patton, adding M-113 armoured cars and M-60A1 tank-destroyer conversions, and used the laser-guided Miz'an anti-tank missile, which locked on before the enemy's own missile arrived. On the artillery side the Egyptians had 152mm self-propelled howitzers and the Samid 105mm self-propelled gun, the Syrians had the BM-21 Katyusha rocket launcher, and the Israelis had 155mm self-propelled howitzers and the Solomon self-propelled antitank gun. In the air the Israeli Air Force had the Mirage IIIC and IIJD, the Super Étendard, the A-4 Skyhawk, the F-4 Phantom and the A-6 Intruder, while Egypt flew the MiG-21MF, the MiG-17F and the Su-7. The widest gap of all was at sea: Israel had Sa'ar 4.5 missile boats, the destroyer Eilat and the submarine Dakar, while Egypt had Soviet Komar-class missile boats and 641-type submarines, and the Styx anti-ship missiles carried by those boats were the weapons that sank two Israeli warships in this war. The Eilat had herself been converted from a British County-class destroyer and so belonged to the same British shipbuilding bloodline as the ironclad on the card.
tactics: 10月6日下午兩時，埃及與敘利亞在數百架戰鬥機掩護下同時發動總攻。埃及先以逾兩千門火炮對巴爾萊夫防線實施五十分鐘的密集火力準備，再由數百輛坦克在步兵支援下分批強渡蘇伊士運河，主要渡點在「大苦湖」以北的德維索瓦伊爾，以及伊斯梅利亞與費達尼之間，首日過河部隊逾四千人，二十四小時內過河車輛逾一萬五千輛；空降與突擊分隊乘直升機在縱深灘頭建立數十個據點，巴爾萊夫防線當夜被突破，縱深達十餘公里。敘利亞在戈蘭方向以正面的裝甲突擊展開攻勢，以軍預設的「沙漏」防線一度被突破，敘利亞裝甲縱隊在「哭泣谷」遭以軍裝甲預備隊攔截。以軍的戰術主軸是縱深機動作戰與預設陣地反擊：10月9日夜對戈蘭發動反攻奪回失地，10日夜以空降兵攻佔庫奈特拉，11日攻下米茲佩·什米拉姆堡壘，12日切斷大馬士革至安曼的公路，使戈蘭以西的敘利亞部隊與本土陷於隔絕；西奈方面以軍於10月14日實施「半程點」反攻，納哈爾裝甲師當夜在德維索瓦伊爾架設浮橋渡河，16日奪回中國農場並解救出被俘的以軍官兵，切斷了埃及第3集團軍的補給線。海戰方面，10月20日埃及「科馬爾」級導彈艇以「Styx」導彈擊中以色列驅逐艦「埃拉特」號與導彈艇「米茲拉希」號，兩艇相繼沉沒；戰後以色列在蘇伊士運河航道上佈雷封鎖，運河遲至1975年才由聯合國排雷隊清理重開。
tacticsEn: At 14:00 on 6 October Egypt and Syria launched their general offensive simultaneously, under cover of several hundred fighters. The Egyptians first laid a fifty-minute barrage from more than two thousand guns against the Bar-Lev Line, then sent several hundred tanks across the canal in batches with infantry support, the main crossing points lying north of the Great Bitter Lake at Deversoir and between Ismailia and Feda'i. More than four thousand men crossed on the first day and more than fifteen thousand vehicles passed over within twenty-four hours, while airborne and assault detachments flew in by helicopter to establish dozens of strongpoints well forward on the far bank. The Bar-Lev Line was broken that night and the penetration driven more than ten kilometres into the interior. In the Golan the Syrians attacked frontally with armoured columns, at one point breaking through the Israeli Hourglass line, but their armoured spearhead was caught in the Valley of Tears by the Israeli armoured reserve. The central Israeli tactical answer was deep manoeuvre and a counterstroke from prepared positions: on the night of 9 October they counter-attacked in the Golan and retook the lost ground, on the 10th airborne troops took Quneitra, on the 11th the fort of Mitzpe Shmiram, and on the 12th the Damascus–Amman highway was cut, isolating the Syrian troops west of the Golan from the homeland. In Sinai the Israeli counter-offensive around the Halfway Point was launched on 14 October, the Nahal armoured division bridging the canal at Deversoir overnight, retaking the Chinese Farm on the 16th, freeing the Israeli prisoners held there and cutting the supply line of the Egyptian Third Army. At sea, on 20 October, Egyptian Komar-class missile boats struck the Israeli destroyer Eilat and the missile boat Mizrahi with Styx missiles, and both vessels sank in turn. After the war Israel mined the shipping channel of the Suez Canal, and the canal was not cleared and reopened until 1975 by international demining teams.
data: 時間：1973年10月6日開火，10月22日埃及與以色列接受安理會第338號決議，10月24日全面停火，27日最後一場戰鬥結束，前後約十九天；埃以脫離接觸協定於1974年9月18日簽署，1975年1月26日完成。兵力：以色列動員約三十萬人，埃及投入西奈方向約二十萬人，敘利亞投入戈蘭方向約六萬人，阿拉伯聯盟另有數萬人。坦克：埃及在首日攻勢中投入約二百輛坦克，全役可作戰坦克逾二千輛，以色列投入約七百輛，雙方全役坦克損失以數百輛計，埃及方面永久損失逾一千輛。航空：以軍全役損失一百零二架飛機，其中空對空作戰損失三十五架；埃及損失數百架。空運：美國「鎳草行動」出動C-141、C-5與C-130逾一千架次，向以軍空運物資約三萬三千噸。反戰車導彈：開戰頭三日埃及消耗AT-3「薩格」導彈逾兩千發。海上：10月20日兩艘以色列軍艦被擊沉，驅逐艦「埃拉特」號四十七人殉職，導彈艇「米茲拉希」號大多數官兵殉難；11月27日以色列潛艇「達卡爾」號在北大西洋的北約公演中失事，四十六名官兵殉難。傷亡：以色列官方公布陣亡約二千六百人、受傷約七千人，埃及公布陣亡約一萬五千人、受傷約四萬五千人，敘利亞陣亡約三千五百人、受傷約一萬人。
dataEn: Duration: the war opened on 6 October 1973, Egypt and Israel accepted Security Council Resolution 338 on 22 October, the general ceasefire took effect on 24 October and the last engagement ended on the 27th — about nineteen days in all; the Egyptian–Israeli disengagement agreement was signed on 18 September 1974 and completed on 26 January 1975. Manpower: Israel mobilised roughly 300,000 men, Egypt committed about 200,000 in the Sinai direction and Syria some 60,000 towards the Golan, with tens of thousands more contributed by the rest of the Arab coalition. Armour: roughly 200 tanks were committed by Egypt in the opening attack and more than two thousand combat tanks were available over the whole campaign, against about 700 Israeli tanks; losses on both sides ran into the hundreds, Egypt permanently losing more than a thousand. Air: the Israeli Air Force lost 102 aircraft over the campaign, of which 35 went in air combat, while Egypt lost several hundred. Airlift: Operation Nickel Grass flew more than a thousand sorties of C-141, C-5 and C-130 aircraft, delivering about 33,000 tonnes of materiel to the Israeli forces. Anti-tank missiles: Egypt expended more than two thousand Sagger missiles in the first three days. At sea: two Israeli warships were sunk on 20 October, the destroyer Eilat with 47 dead and the missile boat Mizrahi with most of her crew lost; on 27 November the Israeli submarine Dakar was lost during a NATO exercise in the North Atlantic, 46 of her men dying. Casualties: Israel officially reported about 2,600 dead and 7,000 wounded, Egypt about 15,000 dead and 45,000 wounded, and Syria about 3,500 dead and 10,000 wounded.
cause: 導火索是1972年以來不斷惡化的被佔土問題。1971年起以軍在約旦河西岸與其他被佔地區大量增建定居點，埃及與敘利亞認為拖延愈久愈對以色列有利；1972年7月埃及以「安插蘇聯顧問」的名義驅逐蘇聯軍事顧問，與莫斯科關係惡化，同年11月埃及派出高層代表團訪問以色列沿途城市，試圖以開放邊境、和平共處的姿態爭取外交主動，但戈蘭高地與約旦河西岸的歸屬問題毫無進展，談判於1973年9月再度破裂。真正促使薩達特下定決心的，是1973年8月美國向沙烏地阿拉伯交付F-15戰鬥機並向埃及提供空軍裝備，阿拉伯國家普遍視之為美國偏袒以色列的訊號；9月25日薩達特批准作戰計畫，選在猶太曆九月九日、贖罪日之前開火，刻意利用以色列軍方人手不足與民間休假之際。埃及軍隊在1967年慘敗後進行了六年整頓，士氣與指揮體系均已恢復；敘利亞則因1973年4月以軍空襲大馬士革造成敘利亞軍官傷亡而強烈要求報復。開戰前的情報判斷則出現重大偏差，情報部門對以軍備、後備與士氣的估計失準，暴露了情報體系的嚴重失靈。
causeEn: The spark was the deteriorating situation in the occupied territories that had been building since 1972. From 1971 onward the Israelis had been establishing settlements on a large scale in the West Bank and elsewhere in the occupied areas, and Egypt and Syria judged that every month of delay favoured Israel. In July 1972 Egypt expelled its Soviet military advisers, souring its relations with Moscow, and in November of that year a high-ranking Egyptian delegation visited Israeli cities along a route of their own choosing, seeking a diplomatic initiative built on opening the borders and living side by side; but the questions of the Golan Heights and the West Bank made no progress and the talks broke down again in September 1973. What finally persuaded Sadat was the delivery of F-15 fighters to Saudi Arabia and air-force equipment to Egypt by the United States in August 1973, which the Arab states read as a signal of American favouritism towards Israel; on 25 September Sadat approved the operational plan and chose to open fire on the ninth day of the Jewish month of Tishrei, the day before Yom Kippur, deliberately taking advantage of the thin manpower and widespread leave in the Israeli armed forces. The Egyptian army had spent six years rebuilding itself after the catastrophe of 1967 and had recovered in both morale and command structure, while Syria was driven by the Israeli raid on Damascus in April 1973, which cost the Syrian military officers and turned the attack into a matter of vengeance. Intelligence assessment before the opening salvo was badly wrong, with the state of Israeli readiness, reserves and morale misjudged, exposing a serious failure in the intelligence system.
impact: 本役是阿拉伯世界對以色列無條件勝利神話的終結。以色列的「阿格拉納特委員會」調查報告承認，指揮部對敵情判斷、後備動員、裝甲與砲兵協同、指揮連續性以及後勤準備皆嚴重不足，該報告成為以色列此後數十年軍事改革的藍圖；國防軍由守勢轉向以縱深機動、預備隊中央集中與快速部隊為核心的理論，1974年後重建的裝甲師、空降旅與後備役制度皆以此為依據。戰爭直接催生了埃及與以色列的脫離接觸談判，1975年9月生效的《西奈中間協定》讓埃及收回西奈並取得油井收益，蘇伊士運河於1975年重開，阿拉伯世界由此分裂，埃及被排除於1978年的阿拉伯峰會之外；1973年的石油禁運使油價急升約四倍，觸發全球能源危機，也把西方對阿拉伯石油的依賴暴露為公開的政治風險。聯合國安理會第338號決議確立「停火加談判」的處理框架，而第242號決議的落實問題則被推遲。戰爭亦令以色列更加依賴美國的空運與情報支援，刺激本國航空工業的「幼獅」與「梟」式機計劃；外交上，美國承認未事先諮詢開羅盟友，停火受挫令基辛格的穿梭被批評為太遲，中東亦由二戰後的西方勢力範圍轉為美蘇競逐的新前線。
impactEn: This war was the end of the myth of Arab invincibility against Israel. The Agranat Commission inquiry in Israel found serious shortcomings in the assessment of the enemy, in the mobilisation of reserves, in the coordination between armour and artillery, in the continuity of command and in logistic preparation, and its report became the blueprint for Israeli military reform over the following decades. The defence forces turned from a defensive posture towards a doctrine built on deep manoeuvre, central control of reserves and fast-moving forces, and the armoured divisions, airborne brigades and reserve system rebuilt after 1974 all followed that line. The war led directly to the Egyptian–Israeli disengagement talks, and the Sinai Interim Agreement that took effect in September 1975 returned Sinai to Egypt together with the oil revenues, while the Suez Canal reopened in 1975; the Arab world was split by the war, and Egypt was excluded from the Arab summit of 1978. The 1973 oil embargo sent prices up roughly fourfold, triggered the world energy crisis, and exposed the Western dependence on Arab oil as an open political risk. Security Council Resolution 338 established the framework of ceasefire plus negotiation, while implementation of Resolution 242 was deferred. The war also made Israel more dependent on American airlift and intelligence support and stimulated the native aircraft industry with the Kfir and the Nesher programmes. Diplomatically, the United States conceded that it had not consulted its Cairo allies, the late ceasefire drew heavy criticism of Kissinger's shuttle, and the Middle East passed from the post-war Western sphere to a new Soviet–American front line.
result: 10月22日埃及與以色列接受安理會第338號決議，24日零時起全面停火，27日最後一場戰鬥結束。停火線大致維持戰前態勢：埃及守住蘇伊士運河南岸與西奈縱深，卻未能在戰術上消滅以軍主力；以色列退守戈蘭高地的「沙漏」線以內，但切斷了大馬士革至安曼的公路，使戈蘭以西地區與敘利亞本土的聯繫中斷，米茲佩·什米拉姆堡壘等據點歸以軍控制，敘利亞失去戈蘭的縱深；約旦軍隊於10月11日退出戰鬥。埃及第3集團軍在中國農場方向被切斷補給，以軍在10月下旬推進至「半程點」一線即告停止，本役並未演變成推倒開羅的戰爭。國際上，美國在停火過程中承認自己未事先諮詢開羅盟友，基辛格的穿梭斡旋被批評為太遲；1974年9月18日以埃簽署脫離接觸協定，1975年1月26日完成，1975年9月4日《西奈中間協定》生效，埃及收回西奈主權並獲得蘇伊士灣的石油。1973年10月之後，阿拉伯國家對以色列的策略由消滅戰爭轉為有限消耗與政治鬥爭，以色列則明白一場常規戰爭並不保證迅速取勝。
resultEn: On 22 October Egypt and Israel accepted Security Council Resolution 338, the general ceasefire took effect at midnight on the 24th, and the last engagement of the war ended on the 27th. The ceasefire line broadly held the pre-war situation: Egypt kept the south bank of the Suez Canal and the depth of Sinai, but never destroyed the Israeli main force tactically, while Israel fell back inside the Hourglass line in the Golan but cut the Damascus–Amman highway, severing the link between the area west of the Golan and the Syrian homeland; the fort of Mitzpe Shmiram and other positions passed to Israeli control and Syria lost the depth of the Golan. The Jordanian army withdrew from the fighting on 11 October. The supply of the Egyptian Third Army was cut in the Chinese Farm direction, and the Israeli advance along the Halfway Point road halted in late October — this war never became a march on Cairo. Internationally, the United States admitted that it had not consulted its Cairo allies, and Kissinger's shuttle was judged too late; on 18 September 1974 Egypt and Israel signed the disengagement agreement, which was completed on 26 January 1975, and the Sinai Interim Agreement took effect on 4 September 1975, returning sovereignty over Sinai to Egypt together with the oil of the Gulf of Suez. After October 1973 the Arab states shifted their strategy towards Israel from a war of annihilation to one of limited attrition and political struggle, while Israel learned that a conventional war does not guarantee a quick decision.
